 Print General: With the Moon positioned in Gemini in your twelfth house, privacy, relaxation, and tying up loose ends are highlighted throughout the day. You’re likely to favor a calmer routine with fewer distractions pulling at your focus. Meanwhile, an exalted Jupiter in Cancer occupying your first house encourages practical initiative and a reflective approach to your personal goals. Channel that self‑assurance into trimming excess obligations and bringing order to any lingering projects. A quiet, personal assessment will be more effective today than chasing a hectic, public spotlight. Love and Relationship: Disagreements about money, schedules, or home arrangements often require a softer touch. Allow your partner to finish their thoughts before you reply. With Mercury retrograde near the Sun in Libra occupying your fourth house, it’s especially important to make household communications clear. If a sibling or other relative presents an unforeseen request, address the specifics straight away. Engaging in a calm, shared activity can restore harmony more efficiently than persisting in a conversation once both parties are fatigued. Education and Career: A retrograde Saturn positioned in Pisces in your ninth house encourages you to adopt lasting habits such as careful preparation, diligent study, and valuing seasoned advice. Today is ideal for verifying academic prerequisites, sorting reference documents, or re‑examining a challenging lesson. If your job or studies involve travel, double‑check the logistics before finalizing plans. You’ll perform best when distractions are minimal. Use this time to finish a background task that will simplify a future submission, and consult a mentor for a clear, specific answer when needed. Money and Finance: Expenses can dominate your focus more than income, so prioritize essential payments. With retrograde Rahu in Aquarius in the eighth house and retrograde Ketu in Leo in the second house, shared obligations and personal finances line up. Examine reimbursements, subscriptions, and joint bills with exact numbers at hand. Hold off on new investments until you can devote more attention to comparing options. Today is best for recognizing where your money is already pledged. Health and Well-being: A slower tempo will probably work better for you than trying to power through a jam‑packed schedule. With a weakened Mars in Cancer in your first house, it’s wise to use your physical stamina in moderation. Choose comfortable workouts and give yourself a chance to relax before bedtime. Cutting down on excess noise and screen time during your downtime can also help. Make sure you consistently meet basic needs—like eating and staying hydrated rather than squeezing them in between every other commitment. Tip for the Day: Set aside quiet time to review expenses and close one unfinished obligation.
